Daddy Had a Good Reason for Abandoning You: It's unclear how involved Declan would have been otherwise, but at least he has the excuse that he's spent much of Jesse's life working deeply undercover overseas, to the point he need mandatory rehab (twice) when he was finally pulled out. Jesse is implied to at least know he exists, since she finds it plausible that Sonny is her sister's father, but not hers. Hereditary Hairstyle: Members of her maternal family are all blondes just like her. Heroic Bastard: Her parents are not married.

characters.name: Billie Rollins
characters.description: Amanda's daughter with Dr. Al Pollack. Hereditary Hairstyle: Is blonde like her sister, mother, aunt, and grandmother. Heroic Bastard: Her parents are not married. Nom de Mom: She uses her mother's surname due to her parents not being married. Parental Abandonment: Dr. Al is not involved in Billie's life, and appears not to have been since Amanda rejected his marriage proposal. Billie doesn't even appear to know he exists, since it becomes a plot point in season 23 that Sonny and Amanda'sRelationship Upgradehas her wondering if Sonny is her dad.

characters.name: Mason Rollins
characters.description: Kim's son with an unknown man. Nom de Mom: His parents are not married. Raised by Grandparents: Amanda and Kim's mother takes custody of him after Kim voluntarily returns to prison so she can get clean for good.

characters.name: Dominick "Nicky" Carisi III
characters.description: The first son of Amanda Rollins and Sonny Carisi, born after the two started a relationship and got married. Ancestral Name: His father and grandfather are also named Dominick. The Baby of the Bunch: The youngest of Amanda's three kids.

characters.name: Maria Grazie
characters.description: Nick's (eventual ex) wife and a member of the U.S. Army. Action Mom: Mother to Zara and stepmother to Gilberto and a member of the U.S. Army. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: She has a very rigid demeanor. Good-Looking Privates: A character who is a member of the U.S. Army that is played by Laura Benanti. Long-Distance Relationship: She's stationed in Iraq while Nick is in New York. This is part of the reason for their eventual split.

characters.name: Zara Amaro
characters.description: Two First Names: "Zara" and "Amaro".

characters.name: Cesaria Amaro
characters.description: Domestic Abuse: Her husband used to beat her up. Two First Names: "Cesaria" and "Amaro".

characters.name: William Lewis
characters.description: Ax-Crazy: To put it simply, he enjoys the chaos and suffering he reaps, and he exploits his looks to such great, depraved effect. Arch-Enemy: To Benson. Arc Villain: In season 15. Bullying a Dragon: Played straight once, and then subverted the next time. His kidnapping and torture of a trained police officer like Benson wasn't the brightest idea (especially for as smart as he is) when all she needed was one small opening to restrain him. The second time Lewis and Benson had a violent confrontation, however, she was completely at his mercy, and she would have been murdered by him had he not shot himself as one last torture he could inflict on her (by making her look like she'd shot him in cold blood). Cold-Blooded Torture: Has a penchant for tying up his victims, heating up keys and branding victims, and burning them with cigarettes in addition to the usual rape and sodomy.

characters.name: Dr. Greg Yates
characters.description: Bookends: His first and final episodes are both set inChicago P.D.. Boom, Headshot!: How he dispatches some victimsfollowing his escape. This is later how he dies. Calling Card: Paints his victims' fingernails with green nail polish.Following his escape from prison,he leaves behind a taunting letter for the police to find. Character Tics: Has an eerie habit of slowly rolling his head every time he's relishing in his crimes. This is what tips the SVU off to his weakness. Consulting a Convicted Killer: The SVU detectives interrogate him when Carl Rudnick kills a woman and tries to pin it on him.

characters.name: Dr. Carl Rudnick
characters.description: Affably Evil: He's not even a mean guy, he's just very mentally screwed up. Despite being a serial killer, he's also a soft-spoken and respectful individual who forms a genuine friendship of sorts with SVU's residentAll-Loving HeroCarisi. True enough,when Yates leaves Rudnick to die inside of a boat, Carisi goes to the mat to make sure he survives, which Rudnick is genuinely grateful for. Creepy Crossdresser: After he murders his Swiss girlfriend, he dresses as a woman to reenter the U.S. He continues this cross-dressing during the course of his future crimes. Disguised in Drag: Cross-dresses every time he needs to evade authorities. Has a Type: Seems to have a thing for redheads, since they resemble his girlfriend. It's also apparently because of their higher susceptibility to pain. Mad Doctor: A former Medical Examiner, who enjoys carving people up and talks to himself.

characters.name: Bronwyn Freed Wilkins
characters.description: Bound and Gagged: How the team finds her.Stilldefending her friends. Chekhov's Gunman: Appears in the background a few times before her role is revealed. Horrible Judge of Character:She firmly sees Lewis as a helpless, innocent man just cause he’s attractive… while dismissing the butt loads of evidence proving he’s a sociopathic rapist of a serial killer, even going as far as to help break him out of prison. She also thinks Benson is the only villain between the two because she beat up Lewis with a bat…because he kidnap and tortured Benson for days. And proceeds to whine and act like Benson is bullying her, while Benson tearing her a new one for helping Yates and Rudnick escape from prison.She’s learned nothing from automatically judging serial killers as good guys, and helps Rudnick and Yates break out, who leave her for dead, tied up in the trunk of the car… still infatuated with one of them. She also thinks Benson is the only villain between the two because she beat up Lewis with a bat…because he kidnap and tortured Benson for days. And proceeds to whine and act like Benson is bullying her, while Benson tearing her a new one for helping Yates and Rudnick escape from prison. She’s learned nothing from automatically judging serial killers as good guys, and helps Rudnick and Yates break out, who leave her for dead, tied up in the trunk of the car… still infatuated with one of them.

characters.name: Rob Miller
characters.description: Amoral Attorney: He raped fellow lawyer Nikki Staines. Arc Villain: For Season 20. Beard of Evil: He's sporting a thick beard and is a rapist.

characters.name: Bart Ganzel
characters.description: Identical Stranger:Peter Jacobsonhas had a few roles onLaw and Order, including recurring defense attorney Randy Dworkin who has appeared in both the mothership series andSpecial Victims Unit. Put on a Bus to Hell: Sent to prison for life for prostitution, murdering a prostitute and trying to frame Cragen for it, and attempting to kill Cragen and Cassidy. He deserves it.

characters.name: Lewis Hodda
characters.description: Psycho for Hire: An arsonist-for-hire who uses his job to over up his child murders. Would Hurt a Child: He's aSerial Killerwho murders children.

characters.name: Lorraine Dillon and April Troost
characters.description: A mother-and-daughter team of brilliant con artists. April drugged and raped multiple men, using a cattle prod to harvest their sperm for her father's fertility company, using the sperm of one of her victims to get herself pregnant. Abusive Parents: April uses her infant daughter Sarah's location as bargaining chip to get immunity for her crimes. Big Bad: April is the main villain of theSVUSeason 7 episode "Design" and theLaw & OrderSeason 16 episode "Flaw." False Rape Accusation: April does this to her victim Barclay Pallister, the father of her child. Karma Houdini Warranty: After avoiding prison in theirSVUappearance, they finally get jailed on the parent show.

characters.name: Johnny Drake
characters.description: A notorious sex trafficker and the biological father of Noah Porter-Benson. Disappeared Dad: Killed by Amaro in a courthouse shootout while Noah's a baby. Needless to say, Noah's better off without him. Greater-Scope Villain: Luke, I Am Your Father: Is revealed to be Noah's biological father at the end of his debut episode. Serial Rapist: Comes with being a notorious sex trafficker.

characters.name: Gary Munson
characters.description: A Riker's Island corrections officer who used his position to rape multiple female inmates. Arc Villain: Of the final two episodes of Season 17. Cop Killer: Responsible for the death of Sgt. Mike Dodds. Crime After Crime: Was already facing hard prison time and registering as a sex offender for multiple counts of rape, his killing of Sgt. Dodds ensures he'll get life without parole. Domestic Abuse: Takes his wife hostage when she decides to leave him after realizing his guilt.

characters.name: Fran Stanton
characters.description: A psychiatrist who falsely diagnosed her underage patient Andrew Hingham with schizophrenia so she could pursue a sexual relationship with him. Absurdly Elderly Mother: Assuming she's close to her actress' age (Ally Walker was 49 when she filmed her episode), Dr. Stanton was in her late 40's when she conceived a baby she's revealed to have had with Andrew. Believing Their Own Lies: During her interrogation, she insists that she loves Andrew and that "he's a man", fully believing that her molestation of him is a loving relationship. Big Bad: Of the Season 11 episode "Conned." Ephebophile: Raped Andrew for 3 years from ages 13 to 16, to the point she bore his son.

characters.name: Pam Adler
characters.description: A lawyer who took part in the rape of a male stripper at her friend's bachelorette party. Amoral Attorney: A defense attorney who took part in raping stripper Peter Smith. Big Bad: Of the Season 3 episode "Ridicule." Double Standard: Rape, Female on Male: Exploited. She thought nothing of forcing herself on male stripper Peter Smith along with her friends Amelia and Sydney and, in-universe, several characters doubt what they did is even possible. She's only sentenced for a minor assault charge for raping Peter. However... Justice by Other Legal Means: She manages to escape conviction for raping Peter, but in the meantime the detectives have convinced the other perp Amelia to testify against her for killing Sydney. She's arrested before she's even left the courthouse.

characters.name: Rowan Mauer
characters.description: Baby Be Mine: Kidnapped six year-old Kevin Brown after an altercation with her abusive husband resulted in her son Emerson's accidental death, raising Kevin under Emerson's name. Big Bad: Of the Season 20 episode "Missing." Entitled Bitch: Says that she deserved to have Kevin after losing her son. Olivia responds that no one "deserves someone else's child." It's All About Me: Kidnapped Kevin to be a mother again, not caring at all about the pain she put the Brown family through. Lack of Empathy: After Kevin's sister Diane tells her their mother was dying of Hodgkin's at the time of the abduction and that was why Rowan never saw her around in response to Rowan's claim that Mr. and Mrs. Brown didn't care about their kids, Rowan's response is "even better," saying she made sure Kevin had a mom to grow up with.

characters.name: Amelia Chase
characters.description: Erotic Asphyxiation: This is her hobby, and what she tried to make Sydney Green. Evil Redhead: A rapist who possesses red hair. Identical Stranger: Played by Diane Neal, who would return to the show two years later as ADA Casey Novak.

characters.name: Linda Cook
characters.description: Big Bad: Of "Stolen." Never My Fault: When she and Robert are asked to provide DNA to prove their son Brandon is not Jennifer's son, she blames Robert for not keeping it in his pants, when this is only happening because she murdered Jennifer.

characters.name: Sister Peg
characters.description: A Catholic nun who lived and worked in New York City. Most of her work involves helping and protecting prostitutes. As such, she sometimes comes into contact with Manhattan SVU Detectives Elliot Stabler and Olivia Benson. Usually referred to as "the one who gives prostitutes clean needles." Back for the Dead:After last appearing in Season 8, she returns to the show in the Season 12 finale, only to be killed off by theVictim of the Weekwho snaps and started shooting. Being Good Sucks: In episodes where theVictim of the Weekis a prostitute, their pissed as fuck pimps usually try to get them back and beat up Peg for getting in their way. Black Boss Lady: She runs a shelter for homeless people and sex workers who want to start over. Butt-Monkey: The sex workers or homeless people she helps on-screen oftentimes bring nothing but bad news, at times even getting Sister Peg hurt for her troubles.

characters.name: Reverend Curtis
characters.description: A reverend who acts as a representative of the lower class of the population. Expy: Of the character of Sister Peg in that he works for the people he sees as victims, but different from her in that he's not even half as helpful to the detectives as she was and is a lot more critical if the detectives or theADAsdraw attention away from the social aspect of cases. Hypocrite: He’s a crusader for those he sees as the less fortunate and will call out anyone that he sees getting in the way of his agenda to right the system’s wrongs. However, he's willing to turn a blind eye to his chosen mayoral candidate soliciting photos from a teenage girl without regard for morality or his ethics as a preacher. Malcolm Xerox: He is an ordained minister who engages in aggressive civil rights activism, in addition his head is shaved and he wears horn-rimmed spectacles. As a result both his character and appearance bear some resemblance toMalcolm X. Opportunistic Bastard: Expect him to be at the forefront of any case that involves social class differences.

characters.name: Dr. Cap Jackson
characters.description: A psychiatrist who specializes in treating sex addiction. Actor Allusion: Irons had previously played perhaps the most famous literary paedophile of all time, Humbert Humbert in the movie adaptation of Lolita. He also previously portrayed a father who sleeps with a woman his son is engaged to in Damage. Aerith and Bob: Cap is a very unconventional name. Alcohol-Induced Idiocy: Consuming too much alcohol led him to believe that he molested his own daughter. He actually didn't, but his relationship with her is damaged nonetheless since the one he actually slept with was his daughter's best friend who she was in-love with. Break Them by Talking: Even more adept at this than Huang. In his second appearance, his gentle demeanor is so soothing that the suspect 1) lets him and the cops into her house to investigate the suspected crime scene (despite her initial reluctance), then 2) waives her right to a lawyer (after he stupidly tells her she doesn't need one only to be reprimanded by Stabler) just so she can continue to talk to him.

characters.name: Barclay Pallister
characters.description: Earn Your Happy Ending: After his rapist falsely accuses him of rape, staining his reputation and ruining his marriage, he gets his name cleared and receives custody of his and April's daughter Sarah. Good Parents: Happily takes in Sarah, not holding it against her that she was conceived as a result of him being raped. Papa Wolf: After April's guilt is discovered and she hides Sarah away as a bargaining chip, he pleads with SVU to get Sarah back, even consenting to them cutting April a deal. Red Herring: The episode initially leads the audience to believe he is the rapist and April the victim, only for it to transpire it's the other way around.

characters.name: Stephen Talmadge/Tyler Blake
characters.description: Adoptive Name Change: His birth mother Jennifer Talmadge named him Stephen, with his adopted parents Adam and Erin Blake renaming him Tyler. Happily Adopted: Loves and is loved in turn by his adoptive parents, the only parents he's ever known, and he's devastated when the court takes him away from them after his biological father Robert Cook sues for custody and wins, though it's implied Robert will keep the Blakes in his life. Insistent Terminology: After finding out about his birth family he insists on being called by his adopted name. Nom de Mom: His original surname is that of his mother's.

characters.name: Evie Barnes
characters.description: Broken Bird: Is expelled from from school for starring in porn videos and her primary rapist goes free when the judge overturns the guilty verdict out of averymisplaced belief that she didn't mean it when she said "no," leading her to decide to become a full-time porn actor, despite Rollins and Carisi's attempts to convince her to return to her parents. Empty Shell: What her experiences end up turning her into.

characters.name: Lonnie Liston
characters.description: Age-Gap Romance: Barely. Lonnie was 18 years old while his girlfriend was 15 when he was accused by her stepfather. Cruel and Unusual Death: Tortured and lynched to death by white supremacists.
